description.en: The name of the database to be scaled.
The instance ID of the DRDS instance.

description.zh:
扩容类型，取值范围如下：
* smooth_expand：平滑扩容
* hot_expand：热点扩容
description.en:
The scaling type. Valid values:

* **smooth_expand**: smooth scale-out
* **hot_expand**: hotspot update.

description.zh: 该扩容任务的JobId，与ParentJobId取值相同。
description.en: The job ID of the scaling task. The value is the same as that of ParentJobId.

description.zh: 该扩容任务的任务ID，提交扩容任务的请求会返回。
description.en: The task ID of the scaling task. This ID is returned when you submit the scaling task request.

title.en: Submit a cleanup task for a scaling operation

example.unifiedCli: aliyun drds submit-clean-task --drds-instance-id drds000000000 --db-name test --parent-job-id 123 --job-id 123 --expand-type smooth_expand --api-version 2019-01-23 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun drds SubmitCleanTask --region cn-hangzhou --DrdsInstanceId drds000000000 --ExpandType smooth_expand --DbName test --ParentJobId 123 --JobId 123
